name: Swedish Conference in Economics 2028 (Nationalekonomiska konferensen)
organizer: Swedish Economic Association (Nationalekonomiska Föreningen) with a host university
expected_note: Held every two years (2022 Stockholm, 2024 Lund, 2026 Jönköping). The 9th conference (20-21 Nov 2026, Jönköping International Business School) has closed abstract submission; its deadline is not shown on the conference site, so this is a rough estimate from the 2024 abstract deadline (20 June 2024) shifted two cycles. Conference language English; the 2024 edition had no conference fee. 2026 contact: 2026econconference@ju.se.
